entities.summary: Minamitorishima  sometimes Minami-Tori-shima or Minami-Torishima, also known as Marcus Island, is an isolated Japanese coral atoll in the northwestern Pacific Ocean, located some 1,848 km southeast of Tokyo and 1,267 km east of the closest Japanese island, South Iwo Jima of the Volcano Islands, and nearly on a straight line between mainland Tokyo and Wake Island, 1,415 km further to the east-southeast. The closest island to Minamitorishima is East Island in the Mariana Islands, which is 1,015 km to the west-southwest.
